mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_agreement (user_id, agreement_type, agreement_version, agreed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{agreementType}, #{agreementVersion}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE withdrawn_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE user_agreement SET withdrawn_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_agreement_id, user_id, agreement_type, agreement_version, agreed_at, withdrawn_at FROM user_agreement WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY agreement_type, agreement_version
